Imaging and exam findings point toward structural spinal pathology: lumbar X-ray shows **spinal canal narrowing**, and neurological exam reveals **bilateral mild lower extremity weakness** and **stocking-glove sensory loss**, which is atypical for pure mechanical radiculopathy (which usually follows dermatomal patterns) but may suggest either concomitant peripheral neuropathy or more diffuse neurologic involvement.
